data.gender_notes: Nujaim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-j-m' which means 'to defeat' or 'to overcome'. Named for those who have triumphed over adversity and achieved victory in their lives. The name Nujaim carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nujaim usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, strength, and resilience in the face of challenges.
data.etymology: Nujaim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nujaim total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
